title: bug - arrow keys don't work
description: Arrow keys still don't move items in TUI

## Bug Fix: Arrow keys don't work in TUI

### Root Cause
In `pipeline/tui.py`, the `action_focus_previous()` and `action_focus_next()` methods (bound to up/down arrow keys) build the navigable item list incorrectly:

```python
stage_headers = self.query(StageHeader)
feature_items = self.query(FeatureItem)
items = list(stage_headers) + list(feature_items)
```

This concatenates ALL stage headers first, then ALL feature items, which does NOT match the visual (DOM) order. So pressing up/down jumps between unrelated items instead of moving sequentially through the list.

### Fix
Replace the two separate queries with a single CSS selector query that returns items in DOM order:

```python
item_list = list(self.query("StageHeader, FeatureItem"))
```

Textual's `query()` with a comma-separated CSS selector returns all matching widgets in DOM (visual) order, which is exactly what we need for sequential navigation.

### Files Modified
- `pipeline/tui.py`: Fixed `action_focus_previous()` and `action_focus_next()` methods
